title: A Residual-Gate Soft Actor-Critic Controller with Small Language Model Planner for Dual-Axis Solar Tracking Systems
description:
Source code for the RG-SAC dual-axis solar tracking controller. A dual-axis solar tracker is controlled in three layers: an astronomical rule-based schedule provides a smooth base orientation, a sun-position model computes the correction toward the ideal orientation, and a Soft Actor-Critic agent with automatic entropy tuning learns a per-axis gate g in [0,1] deciding how much of that correction to apply. Because g = 0 reproduces the schedule exactly, the classical controller is retained as a structural lower bound, so the learned policy can only add energy and never fall below the baseline.

An hourly planner classifies the weather regime and sets hard constraints (per-hour authority limits, a movement deadband, and the base-pose mode). The planner is a Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct small language model fine-tuned with LoRA on hindsight-optimal targets obtained by scoring every candidate hourly regime in the simulator against a per-activation motor-wear cost.

Evaluation uses a data-driven simulation environment built from NREL/NSRDB irradiance data for Gwangju, South Korea. The NSRDB data itself is not redistributed here; see the README for retrieval instructions.
